subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw change sub-agent bootstrap so Token Plan skill bundles or SKILL.md files are inherited, or keep the current AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md boundary and route Token Plan office workflows through skills/plugins/ClawHub plus docs?
rationale: The code already implements a deliberate sub-agent context boundary and the issue mixes a possible provider/auth bug with a product-level request to restore broad skill context inheritance.

options.title: Keep boundary, verify provider bug
options.body: Keep AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only sub-agent bootstrap, require live MiniMax Token Plan proof, and only fix confirmed provider or media-delivery defects in the owner surface.

options.title: Restore scoped Token Plan skill inheritance
options.body: Approve a new explicit sub-agent skill inheritance contract for trusted Token Plan bundles and require security, docs, and compatibility proof before implementation.

options.title: Route office bundle to ClawHub
options.body: Treat PPT/Word/Excel/PDF helpers as a self-contained skill or plugin package and leave OpenClaw core focused on the provider/tool APIs.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary, verify provider bug
recommendation.body: Keep AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only sub-agent bootstrap, require live MiniMax Token Plan proof, and only fix confirmed provider or media-delivery defects in the owner surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva introduced the current sub-agent bootstrap narrowing that maintainers would need to revise or preserve.
